name: PCR THERMAL CYCLER
desc: Premium Gradient PCR Thermal Cycler engineered for high-throughput DNA amplification and precise molecular diagnostics. Features a 96 x 0.2 ml block capacity driven by a long-service-life Peltier system with an adjustable pressure hot lid and a 5-inch large color touchscreen display.
features: 96 Wells x 0.2 ml amplification block layout
Wide gradient tuning capabilities ranging from 30°C to 99°C
Integrated 5 Inch large color high-resolution touch screen dashboard
High-speed processing performance tracking at 5°C per second
Dual USB 2.0 device ports support with a built-in wireless Wi-Fi module

specifications.Sample Block Capacity: 96 Wells x 0.2 ml amplification block layout
specifications.Operating Temperature Range: High-precision thermal control spanning from 4°C up to 105°C
specifications.Gradient Temperature Settings: Wide gradient tuning capabilities ranging from 30°C to 99°C
specifications.Thermal Display Accuracy: Real-time display resolution index sharp at ± 0.1°C
specifications.Maximum Ramping Rate: High-speed processing performance tracking at 5°C per second
specifications.Maximum Heating Capacity: Steady state heating performance up to 2.5°C per second
specifications.Maximum Cooling Capacity: Regulated state cooling performance below 2.5°C per second
specifications.Time Adjustment Increments: Time increment controls setting from -1 second to 600 seconds
specifications.Peltier Thermal Engine Lifecycle: Long service life Peltier blocks rated for greater than 1,000,000 cycles
specifications.Reliability Non-Breakdown Index: Certified to perform 20,000 times continuous non-breakdown operations
specifications.Sample Loss Protection: Integrated adjustable pressure hot lid preventing volatilizing and dewing
specifications.Operating System Interface: Advanced Android System framework with large internal program storage
specifications.Display Panel Architecture: Integrated 5 Inch large color high-resolution touch screen dashboard
specifications.Chassis Structural Design: Unique left-right separate layouts separating amplification zone from controls
specifications.Network & Data Interfaces: Dual USB 2.0 device ports support with a built-in wireless Wi-Fi module
specifications.Maximum Program Cycles: Supports up to 1000b0 maximum cycle numbers per programmed sequence run
specifications.Physical Footprint (DxWxH): Compact layout space measuring 200 mm x 300 mm x 170 mm
specifications.Equipment Net Weight: Lightweight benchtop layout tracking at exactly 4.5 Kg
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: Universal AC 100 to 240 V, 50-60 Hz stable adaptive electrical line
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty on complete Peltier and logic array
